name: Embed
visualCharacteristics: Embedded third-party page in an iframe, framed (1px border, rounded) by default, loaded when near the viewport.
contentPattern: Single row with the embed URL link. Video variant: the video link (its text is the player title), then optional caption paragraphs; add spacer-before for one blank line above the player.
usage: Embedded maps, dashboards and third-party widgets, and (video variant) YouTube/Vimeo players with a caption. A height-<px> class (e.g. height-1100) sets the frame height.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any iframe embed; add height-<px> to match the source frame height. Use the video variant for YouTube/Vimeo links: watch, youtu.be and Vimeo page links are converted to embed URLs.
